sections.title: 32-41 WHO CAN BE MORE WICKED THAN THE ONE WHO INVENT A LIE AGAINST ALLAH? AND IF ALLAH INTENDS TO HARM YOU, NO ONE CAN SAVE YOU AND IF HE INTENDS TO BESTOW HIS BLESSINGS, NO ONE CAN WITHHOLD

translation.text: Who, then, can be more unjust than he who lied against Allah and denied the Truth when it came to him, calling it a lie? Is there no room for such unbelievers in Hell?

commentary.text: Two big crimes are being mentioned here: (i) Lies against Allah SWT such as, claiming that the angels were the daughters of Allah SWT and that Allah SWT had a son (ii) Denying Allah SWT's existence and rejecting the truth i.e. calling haram as halal, etc.
Allah SWT says there is no one who does more wrong than such a person. Such people make these claims not from a place of knowledge but due to pride and arrogance. For them is Hell!

Lesson: Be very careful when talking about Allah SWT, His Prophets and Islam (in general). God forbid NEVER mock, make fun of or misrepresent what Allah SWT has revealed because the crime is COLOSSAL and the punishment Hell.

translation.text: But he who brought the Truth, and those who confirmed it as true, such are the ones who shall be guarded against the chastisement.

commentary.text: Now the believers are being mentioned. The Prophets and those who affirmed faith; those who live and believe in the Quran will be saved.
Thus, two very clear and distinct paths are being mentioned.

arabic_lines: اَلَيۡسَ اللّٰهُ بِكَافٍ عَبۡدَهٗ ؕ وَيُخَوِّفُوۡنَكَ بِالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنۡ هَادٍ ۚ

translation.text: (O Prophet), does Allah not suffice for His servant? They frighten you with others apart from Him, although he whom Allah lets go astray, none can guide him to the Right Way.

commentary.text: Allah is Sufficient for His Servant

The disbelievers of Makkah used to say to the Prophet (PBUH): You behave insolently in respect of our deities and utter rude words against them. You do not know how powerful they are and what miraculous powers they possess. Anybody who dishonored them was ruined. If you also do not desist from what you say against them, you too will be annihilated.

translation.text: And he whom Allah guides to the Right Way, none can lead him astray. Is not Allah the Most Mighty, the Lord of Retribution?

commentary.text: Whomever Allah SWT guides no one can misguide or mislead. it is a Huge favor from Allah SWT. But Allah SWT guides only those who ask for guidance. Always make dua to ask Allah SWT for guidance.  Do not be of those who are too spiritually arrogant to ask for guidance.

translation.text: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah!” Ask ˹them˺, “Consider then whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah: if it was Allah’s Will to harm me, could they undo that harm? Or if He willed ˹some˺ mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him ˹alone˺ the faithful put their trust.”

commentary.text: Negation of shirk

If you ask them, who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah!” Ask them, 'if it was Allah’s Will to harm you, could the gods/deities that you worship undo that harm? Or if He willed some mercy for you, could they withhold His mercy?”
يَتَوَكَّلُ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِ قُلۡ حَسۡبِىَ اللّٰهُ
Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him ˹alone˺ the faithful put their trust.
Trust fully in Allah SWT while adapting the necessary means.
The Idolaters admit that Allah is the Sole Creator because their gods are incapable. In theory many understand the power of Allah SWT, however, in practice they lack resolve.

sections.title: 42-46 IT IS ALLAH WHO RECALL THE SOULS OF PEOPLE UPON THEIR DEATH AND OF THE LIVING PEOPLE DURING THEIR SLEEP

translation.text: It is Allah Who takes away the souls of people at the hour of their death, and takes away at the time of sleep the souls of those that have not died. Then He retains the souls of those against whom He had decreed death and returns the souls of others till an appointed time. Surely there are Signs in this for a people who reflect.

commentary.text: Allah is the One Who causes Death and gives Life

Then Allah SWT tells us that He is in control of all things and does as He wills. He causes men to die (the "greater death'') when He sends the angels to take men's souls from their bodies and He causes them to "die a lesser death'' when they sleep.

'Taking the souls during sleep,' implies the suspension of the powers of feeling, consciousness, understanding and will. Sleep is called the sister of death. FYI – Till today scientists cannot describe why we go to sleep (unknown phenomena that happens to us every night.)

By this Allah SWT wants every man to realize how life and death are entirely with Him. No one has the guarantee that he/she will certainly get up alive in the morning. No one knows what disaster could befall him/her within the next moment. Thus, man who is so helpless to the Will of Allah SWT would be foolish if he/she turned away or became heedless of Him.
Lesson: Sleep should remind us of death. It comes without our control just like death.
Sunnah: One should dust one’s bed before sleeping. Give it a check. Recite duas before sleeping and then upon waking up.

translation.text: When Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter contract with bitterness, but when deities apart from Allah are mentioned, they are filled with joy.

commentary.text: The Ayat describes a real situation during the Prophet's (PBUH) time, when the unbelievers delighted at the mention of their false deities, but showed clear dislike when God’s oneness or Tawhid was asserted. This evil is common to almost all polytheistic people of the world and even some unfortunate Muslims suffer from it. They profess with the tongue that they believe in Allah SWT, but when One Allah alone is mentioned, or when they are asked to believe in God alone and to implement His law and code of living, they express dislike. Yet, when other systems and laws (pirs/sanits) are mentioned, they demonstrate happiness and delight. Only then are they ready to discuss and argue. This attitude shows as to who is the actual object of their love and esteem.
It is these very people that God is describing in this Ayat; they are the ones, in all communities and generations, who choose deviation and then lead others astray.

Allama Alusi, in his commentary Ruh al-Maani, has related his own experience here. He says: One day I saw that a man was invoking the help of a dead saint in his affliction. I said: O bondsman of Allah, invoke Allah, for He Himself says: If My servants ask you, O Prophet, concerning Me, tell them I am quite near to them. I hear and answer the prayer of the supplicant when he calls to Me, (Surah Al-Baqarah, Ayat 186), Hearing this, the man became angry. The people told me afterwards that he said: This man is a denier of the saints. And some others heard him also say: The saints answer the prayers more promptly than does Allah.

Reflect and look at our hearts – Do our hearts and minds feel constricted upon the mention of the exclusive worship of Allah SWT; do we want to change the subject upon the mention of Allah SWT or does His mention make us feel content and we long for that conversation to continue.

translation.text: Say: “O Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, You it is Who will judge among Your servants concerning what they differed.

commentary.text: This Ayat is the reply to all such deviation mentioned above in (39:45).

sections.title: 47-52 IF THE WRONG DOERS POSSESS ALL THE TREASURES OF THE EARTH AND MUCH MORE BESIDES IT, THEY WILL GLADLY OFFER IT AS A RANSOM TO REDEEM THEMSELVES ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT

translation.text: If the wrong-doers possessed the treasures of the earth in their entirety and as much besides, they would gladly offer it on the Day of Resurrection to redeem themselves from the harrowing chastisement. This because there will appear to them from Allah something (exceedingly dismal which) they had never even imagined.
The evil consequences of their deeds will become fully apparent to them, and what they had scoffed at will encompass them.

commentary.text: No Ransom will be accepted on the Day of Resurrection

On the Day of Resurrection, the wrong-doers (once they see the reality of the punishment) will happily offer the entire world once over as ransom so as to save themselves. Anything and everything including, their children their parents (if they could) because they never expected this outcome.
Of course, this is just an example to illustrate the severity of the punishment on the Day of Reckoning.

translation.text: When an affliction befalls man, he cries out to Us; but when We grant him a favour from Us, he says: “I have been granted this on account of my knowledge.” Nay; this (favour) is a test; but most of them do not know.

commentary.text: Also see (39:8)
How Man changes when He is blessed after suffering Harm

After an affliction or difficult situation has passed and when Allah SWT replaces it with peace and blessings some people ignorantly think that this change of circumstance is because they deserve it or that they have attained this by virtue of their abilities, intelligence etc. Or that Allah SWT knows that they are worthy of this blessing or that they are favorites of Allah SWT.

Whereas the fact is that whoever is being given something here (in this world), is being given it for the sake of a trial/test by Allah SWT. This is a means of the test, and not any reward for ability, otherwise many able and worthy people would not be living in poverty and many unworthy people would not be rolling in prosperity.

Lesson: Blessings are temporary and our behavior is being examined upon receiving the blessing. Thus, it is not so much the blessings that matters rather what matters is our conduct upon receiving the blessings.

translation.text: Their predecessors also said the same, but their earnings proved of no avail to them,

commentary.text: Qarun said the same thing about all his wealth and blessings, that he deserves them. Then in an instant everything was taken away and Qarun was swallowed up by the earth. So, beware of arrogance and pride upon receiving any blessing.

translation.text: and the evil consequences of their deeds overtook them. The wrongdoers among these will also be overtaken by the evil consequences of their deeds. They will be utterly unable to frustrate (Us).

commentary.text: Punishment seized them. Qarun was swallowed up by the earth. An example is given (39:50) and then the punishment or consequence is mentioned. (39:51)
Lesson: The end result of arrogance and pride is most definitely and always bad.

translation.text: Do they not know that Allah enlarges and straitens the provision of whomsoever He pleases? Therein are Signs for those that believe.

commentary.text: The abundance or restriction of provisions is based on another law of Allah SWT, which has some other wisdom. The distribution of provisions does not depend on man’s worthiness and ability, or on his being a favorite of Allah SWT or for being under His wrath.
LESSON: BLESSINGS ARE A TEST – SO VIEW THEM AS SUCH.

(For details, see (Surah At-Taubah, Ayats 55, 69, 85); (Surah Younus, Ayat 17); (Surah Hud, Ayats 3, 27); (Surah Ar-Raad, Ayat 26); (Surah Al-Kahf, Ayats 34-36); (Surah TaHa, Ayats 131-132); (Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayat 105); Surah Al-Mumin: Introduction and (Ayats 55-56); (Surah Ash-Shuara, Ayat 111); (Surah Al-Qasas, Ayats 78, 89) and (E.Ns 54 to 60 of Surah Saba).

sections.title: 53-63 THOSE WHO HAVE TRANSGRESSED AGAINST THEIR SOULS SHOULD NOT DESPAIR OF ALLAH'S MERCY, THEY SHOULD REPENT WHILE THEY CAN

translation.text: Tell them, (O Prophet): “My servants who have committed excesses against themselves, do not despair of Allah's Mercy. Surely Allah forgives all sins. He is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.

commentary.text: The Call to repent before the Punishment comes – Almost universally considered the most optimistic Ayat in the Quran

This is a loving address from Allah SWT when he says 'My servants, do not despair from the mercy of your Raab.' Allah SWT forgives ALL sins no matter the number or gravity. But one must first beg for forgiveness and leave the sin/s. Do not repeat the sin/s after you have repented. Turn to Allah SWT’s humbly in worship and service.

As a matter of fact, this Ayat brought a message of hope for those people who had committed mortal sins like murder, adultery, theft, robbery, etc. in the days of ignorance and had despaired whether they would ever be forgiven. To them it has been said: Do not despair of Allah SWT's mercy; whatever you might have done in the past, if you sincerely turn to your Lord in sha Allah you will be forgiven every sin.
For further explanation, see (Surah Al-Furqan, Ayats 70-71)

translation.text: Turn to your Lord and surrender yourselves to Him before the chastisement over-takes you; for then you will receive no help.

commentary.text: Don’t despair no matter how far you have transgressed. Turn back Now! and Submit. Do not persist or justify your sins or despair that there is no help/hope. This Ayat makes clear that Allah SWT does not mind forgiving his servants in fact Allah SWT rejoices when sinners come to him.
Hadiths that tell us not to despair:
Imam Ahmad recorded that Anas bin Malik, may Allah be pleased with him, said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah SWT say:
By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, if you were to commit sin until your sins filled the space between heaven and earth, then you were to ask Allah SWT for forgiveness, He would forgive you.

translation.text: Follow the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord before the chastisement suddenly comes upon you without you even being aware of it.”

commentary.text: Also see (39:18)

Follow what Allah SWT has revealed and strive in attainting the best, that is, be the best in your worship, be the best with people, be the best in performing good deeds thus strive for excellence in religion. Carry out the commands Allah SWT has given, refrain from what He has forbidden, and learn lessons from what He has brought out in the parables and narratives.
Don’t delay as punishment can come suddenly.

translation.text: so that no ˹sinful˺ soul will say ˹on Judgment Day˺, ‘Woe to me for neglecting ˹my duties towards˺ Allah, while ridiculing ˹the truth˺.’

commentary.text: REGRET!

translation.text: and lest a person should say: “If only Allah had guided me, I should have been one of the God-fearing”;

commentary.text: REGRET on the DoJ for the disbelievers who were busy in this life following their false gods and making money, status their religion. Never taking religion seriously they will have nothing but REGRET.

translation.text: or lest he should say, when he sees the chastisement: “O that I might return again, and be among those who do good.”

commentary.text: REGRET – REGRET – REGRET.
Lesson:  Make wise choices now! So as to avoid regret when regret does not matter or make any difference.

sections.title: 64-70 WORSHIP ALLAH AND BE AMONG HIS THANKFUL SERVANTS AND ON THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT THE BOOK OF DEEDS WILL BE OPEN AND JUSTICE WILL BE DONE WITH ALL FAIRNESS

translation.text: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are you urging me to worship ˹anyone˺ other than Allah, O ignorant ones?”

commentary.text: Again, the theme of Tawhid (as in the beginning of the Surah)

The reason for the revelation of this Ayat was narrated by Ibn Abi Hatim and others from Ibn Abbas, may Allah be pleased with him, that the idolators in their ignorance called the Messenger of Allah to worship their gods, then they would worship his God with him. Then these words were revealed.

translation.text: They did not recognise the true worth of Allah. (Such is Allah's power that) on the Day of Resurrection the whole earth will be in His grasp, and the heavens shall be folded up in His Right Hand. Glory be to Him! Exalted be He from all that they associate with Him.

commentary.text: On the authority of Abdullah bin Umar and Abu Hurairah, once during a sermon the Prophet (PBUH) recited this Ayat and then said: Allah SWT will hold the heavens and the earths (i.e. the planets) in His grasp and will roll them about in such a way as a child rolls a ball and will say: I am God, the One: I am the King: I am the All-Mighty, Owner of glory: Where are the kings of the world? Where are the tyrants? Where are the arrogant?
Lesson: We should make an effort to understand the majesty of Allah SWT and act accordingly and thus give Allah SWT the respect, honor, appreciation and gratitude that is His due/right.

translation.text: And the Trumpet shall be blown and all who are in the heavens and the earth shall fall down dead save those whom Allah wills. Then the Trumpet shall be blown again, and lo! all of them will be standing and looking on.

commentary.text: Here, mention has been made of the Trumpets being blown only twice. However, in Surah An-Naml Ayat 87 there is mention of another blowing of the Trumpet before these two, upon hearing which everything in the earth and the heavens will be struck with terror. On this very basis, the hadith below mentions that the Trumpet will be blown thrice:
(1) Nafakhat al-Fazaon, hearing which everything will be struck with terror.
(2) Nafakhat as-Saaq, on which everyone will fall down dead,
(3) Nafakhat al-qiyam li-Rabbit-alamin, i.e. the Trumpet on the blowing of which all dead men will return to life and arise from their graves to present themselves before their Lord.

For the explanation of Thoor (Trumpet), see (Surah Al- Anaam, Ayat 73); (Surah Ibrahim, Ayat 48); (Surah Al-Kahf, Ayat 99); (Surah TaHa, Ayats 102-103); (Surah Al-Hajj, Ayat 1); (Surah Al-Momioon, Ayat 101); (Surah An-Naml, Ayat 87).

translation.text: The earth shall shine with the light of its Lord, and the Scroll (of deeds) shall be set in place, and the Prophets and all witnesses shall be brought, and judgement shall be justly passed among them, and they shall not be wronged;

commentary.text: The earth will be shining with Allah SWT's Nur and will be flat and smooth – (no mountains etc.). The book of deeds will be open and everything will be in front of us.  The witnesses will be present including the Prophets who will bear witness to the effect that the Message of Allah SWT had been conveyed to the people as well as those who will bear witness to the acts and deeds of the people. It is not necessary that these witnesses will be only human beings. The angels, the jinns, the beasts, men’s own limbs, their dwelling places and the trees and stones, will all be included among the witnesses.

translation.text: and everyone shall be paid in full for all that he did. Allah is best aware of all that they do.

commentary.text: 100 % compensation for every deed. With this final judgment people will be separated – Heaven and Hell.

sections.title: 71-75 AFTER JUDGEMENT UNBELIEVERS WILL BE DRIVEN TO HELL AND THE RIGHTEOUS WILL BE LED TO PARADISE IN THRONGS/GROUPS

translation.text: (After the judgment has been passed) Those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in ˹successive˺ groups. زُمَرًا Zumar When they arrive there, its gates will be opened and its keepers will ask them: “Did messengers not come to you from among yourselves, reciting to you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the coming of this Day of yours?” The disbelievers will cry, “Yes ˹indeed˺! But the decree of torment has come to pass against the disbelievers.”

commentary.text: How the Disbelievers will be driven to Hell

After the judgment is over, the disbelievers will be lead in continuous throngs/groups to their eternal destination of Hell. The gates of Hell will not have already been opened but will be opened upon their arrival just as the gates of a prison are opened on the arrival of the culprits and closed as soon as they have entered.  Then the keepers of Hell, who are stern, severe and strong angels, will say to them by way of rebuking and reprimanding: "How could you come here – were you not warned or were you unaware?" The residents of Hell will say," Yes, we were warned." Now the punishment has been established.

Allah SWT tells us how the doomed disbeliever will be driven to Hell by force, with threats and warnings, they will be pushed and forced towards it, and they will be extremely thirsty – and in that state, they will be blind, dumb and deaf, and some of them will be walking on their faces.
' Successive groups’/ 'throngs’ or ‘crowds’ (Az-Zumar) is the name of this Surah. It means people of similar ilk i.e. Pharon and his followers etc.

Lesson: On the Day of Judgment people will be with those who they resemble/admire/emulate in this world.  Reflect upon who are closet to you and their influence upon you. Choose your five closest companions -- you are on the religion/moral compass of your closet friends.

translation.text: It will be said to them, “Enter the gates of Hell, to stay there forever.” What an evil home for the arrogant!

commentary.text: Not surrendering or submitting to Allah SWT due to arrogance and pride is Shirk. For such Hell is their permanent address.
May we be spared the agony/torment and humiliation of Hell -- in sha Allah.

translation.text: And those who were mindful of their Lord will be led to Paradise in ˹successive˺ groups.  زُمَرًا Zumar. When they arrive at its ˹already˺ open gates, its keepers will say, “Peace be upon you! You have done well, so come in, to stay forever.”

commentary.text: The Believers will be taken to Paradise

The word is the same, 'throngs,' or 'groups',' زُمَرًا Zumar but the style/manner changes. Believers will be taken with honor and dignity, smoothly and quickly to Heaven. When they arrive at the gates of Paradise the gates will already be open for them (as a sign of honor) and the angelic gatekeepers will meet them with glad tidings, greetings of peace and praise. Unlike the gatekeepers of Hell who will meet the disbelievers with rebuke and reprimand, the believers will be filled with happiness and joy, each according to his degree of luxury and delights. What happens after this is not mentioned; it is left up to the imagination to think of its dearest wishes and be filled with hope. It is known from the Sahih Hadith that Paradise has eight gates.

arabic_lines: وَقَالُوا الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡ صَدَقَنَا وَعۡدَهٗ وَاَوۡرَثَنَا الۡاَرۡضَ نَتَبَوَّاُ مِنَ الۡجَـنَّةِ حَيۡثُ نَشَآءُ ۚ فَنِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَ

translation.text: The righteous will say, “Praise be to Allah Who has fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the ˹everlasting˺ land to settle in Paradise wherever we please.” How excellent is the reward of those who work ˹righteousness˺!

commentary.text: When the believers see the great reward, splendors, blessing and grand generosity, they will say,الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ  (All the praises and thanks be to Allah SWT Who has fulfilled His promise to us), meaning, `the promise which He made to us through His Messengers who called us to this in the world.'
May we be of those who enter paradise – Ameen.
For explanation, see (Surah Ta Ha, Ayats 106-107,124); (Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayats 106-107 )

arabic_lines: وَتَرَى الۡمَلٰٓـئِكَةَ حَآفِّيۡنَ مِنۡ حَوۡلِ الۡعَرۡشِ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡۚ وَقُضِىَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَقِيۡلَ الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ

translation.text: You shall see the angels surrounding the Throne, glorifying their Lord with His praise, and judgement will have been made among them with fairness, and it will be proclaimed: “All praise and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of the whole Universe.”

commentary.text: Thus is the depiction of the Day of Judgment.

After judgment has been passed in the most fair and perfect manner, and after all people have gone to their respective destinations. Then all the angels will surround the Throne of Allah SWT – praising Allah SWT. These will be the sounds of Heaven, “الۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ “Subhan Allah, Al Hamdul ilAllah and zikr of Allah SWT.
The entire Universe will proclaim the praises of Allah All-Might.

items.text: THE WORLD HAS BEEN IS CREATED FOR MAN AND MAN IS CREATED FOR THE HEREAFTER.
Although the concepts in this Surah are clear we are encouraged to think and contemplate – so as to gain a much deeper, accurate and more thoughtful appreciation.

Important to note that here Allah SWT is discussing Tawhid via action as opposed to Tawhid via mere lip service. If life’s only purpose was to eat, sleep, produce children etc., then we are no different from the animal kingdom. But God has bestowed on mankind intellect, the subservience of the universe, and the freedom of choice therefore we are held at a much higher standard and must worship the Lord who has given us so much.
Nothing on this earth is without a purpose I.e. the sun gives us energy, heat and gives plants life etc., therefore how and why would man be created without a purpose.
Take a holistic approach to religion:

Important to note that our talk must match our walk (deeds) and both must be completely in sync with each other, that is, we cannot be living life as we desire (actions) while proclaiming we are Muslims.

front_matter.label: Theme and Topics
front_matter.text:
There are seven Surahs in the Quran that begin with HaMim and they are:  (i) al-Mu'Min (40), (ii) HaMim al-Sajdah (41) (iii) Ash-Shura (42), (iv) al-Zukhruf (43), (v) al-Dukhan (44) , (vi) al-Jathiyah (45), (vii) al-Ahqaf (46). These seven Surahs are also called "al-Hawamim". They are all Makki Surahs and were revealed one after another. The central theme is Tawhid. These are Surahs of Da'wah, inviting people to the EXCLUSIVE belief in Allah SWT.
The final authority regarding the significance and meaning of these disjointed Arabic letters (HaMim) in the beginning of each Surah is Allah AWT Himself.
The main theme of this Surah is dua but dua sincerely and exclusively to Allah SWT. If you pray to Allah SWT and then worship other deites whether it be your nafs/desires/money or other people etc. then your dua will not be accepted.
The disbelievers have been admonished: "Whatever you intend to do against Muhammad (upon whom be Allah's peace), the same did the Pharaoh intend against the Prophet Musa (PBUH). Now, would you like to meet with the same fate as did Pharon?"

translation.text: the Forgiver of sins, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in retribution, the Bountiful. There is no god but He. To Him are all destined to return.

commentary.text: (40:2) & (40:3) immediately, the listener has been forewarned that what is being presented before you is not the word of an ordinary being but of that God Who has infinite power. After this, some of Allah SWT’s attributes have been mentioned, one after the other;
First, He is All-Mighty, i.e. He is Dominant over everything. His every decree is always enforced.

Second, He is All-Knowing, i.e. He does not say anything on mere conjecture, rather has direct knowledge over everything. He knows in what lies the true success of man and what rules, laws and commands are necessary for his well-being. Thus, His every teaching is based on wisdom and correct knowledge.

Third, He is Forgiver of sins and Acceptor of repentance. This attribute should bring hope to people who have led lives of sin that do not despair instead repent, refrain from sins and beg for Allah SWT's mercy. (This is also the name of the Surah 'Ghafir'غَافِرor acceptor of repentance.)

Fourth, He is stern in punishment. People have been warned that just as Allah SWT is Merciful for those who adopt the way of His service, so He is stern for those who adopt an attitude of rebellion against Him. His punishment is so dreadful that only a fool would persist in his wrongdoing.
Fifth, He is Bountiful, i.e. He is Generous and Beneficent. All creatures are being showered with His blessing, favors bounty and beneficence, every moment of every day.
After these five attributes, two realities have been stated: (i) Allah SWT alone is our Lord and (ii) to Him we must return.
By clearly describing Allah SWT's attributes man is able to establish a relationship with Allah SWT that leaves no room for any ambiguity as to what pleases Him or what incurs His anger.

This is very unlike the people of ignorance who in their confusion to please their false gods/deities resort to sacrifices/charms etc., but are always wondering/confused if they (false gods/deities) were satisfied or not.

translation.text: None disputes the signs of Allah except the disbelievers, so do not be deceived by their prosperity throughout the land.

commentary.text: Those who dispute about God's revelations resort to tactics such as taking one Ayat of the Quran, distort it's meaning to reject another Ayat of the Quran etc. This behavior is only of those who deny or do not want to believe.

However, then even after adopting such an attitude, if one sees these people boasting about, with their business flourishing, their governments thriving and enjoying the good things of life, one should not be misled into thinking that they have escaped Allah SWT’s punishment, or that war against Allah SWT’s revelations can be adopted and its evil consequences warded off easily. This, in fact, is a respite that they have been granted by Allah SWT. Those who abuse this respite by doing more mischief are indeed preparing for an ignominious end.

translation.text: Those ˹angels˺ who carry the Throne and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, have faith in Him, and seek forgiveness for the believers, ˹praying:˺ “Our Lord! You encompass everything in ˹Your˺ mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and protect them from the torment of the Hellfire.

commentary.text: The Bearers of the Throne (Angels) praise Allah and pray for forgiveness for the Believers

Angels surrounding the Throne of Allah SWT ask forgiveness for the believer. The dua of the angels to Allah SWT: ' Forgive by Your Mercy all those who have sincerely repented and have adopted Your way of Iman (surrender). Angels are interceding with Allah SWT on our/your behalf!
Note: End of Surah Az-Zumar angels are praising and surrounding the Throne of Allah SWT.

Etiquette of making dua is to first praise Allah SWT and then make dua. (Example (40:7) Our Lord! You encompass everything with Your Mercy and Knowledge. So forgive those that repent and follow Your Path…

translation.text: Our Lord, admit them to the everlasting Gardens You have promised them and those of their fathers and spouses and progeny that were righteous. Surely You alone are Most Mighty, Most Wise;

commentary.text: Angels are so earnest in their desire for the well-being for the believers that they go on repeating their good wishes for them by asking Allah SWT to grant the believers the same Paradise which He Himself has promised them. And to join them with their parents, wives and children in Heaven. Again, this same thing Allah SWT Himself has stated as among the blessings the believers will be granted in paradise. (see below).

Surah At-Toor, Ayat 21: ' if a person deserves a higher rank in Paradise than his parents, then he will not be lowered in rank instead Allah SWT will raise them (parents) to join him in the higher station.'

translation.text: and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day, to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.”

commentary.text: Dua of Angels continues: “Evils of that Day,” implies the dread and terror of the Day of Judgment that includes the severity of accountability and the humiliation of exposing every secret of life before all mankind that the guilty ones will experience in the Hereafter.
"That is the great triumph,” means that the definition of success is that you have entered Heaven and avoided Hell fire. FYI – What is your definition of Success?
Lesson: Angels are always doing tasbeeh around the Throne of Allah SWT. Similarly, be of those who are constant in the zikr/tasbeeh of their Raab.

translation.text: But those who disbelieved will be told, ‘When you were called to the faith and rejected it, God’s disgust with you was even greater then than the self-disgust you feel [today].’

commentary.text: The Regret of the Disbelievers after they enter Hell

Conversely now, Allah SWT tells us that the disbelievers will feel nothing but utter and sheer regret on the Day of Resurrection when they actually experience the unbearable punishment of Allah SWT. They will hate themselves with the utmost hatred because of the sins they committed in the past resulting in them entering the Fire.

At this point the angels will tell the disbelievers in a loud voice that, Allah SWT's hatred/wrath towards them in this world -- when Faith was offered to them and they rejected it -- was greater than their hatred towards themselves in this situation.
LESSON: UNDERSTAND WHAT CAUSES ALLAH SWT'S HATRED AND AVOID IT AT ALL COSTS.

translation.text: So call upon Allah, consecrating all your devotion to Him, howsoever much the unbelievers may dislike it.

commentary.text: The Believers are commanded to worship Allah SWT Alone no matter what Their Circumstances

Dedicate all worship to Allah SWT alone (EXCLUSIVELY) even if the disbelievers dislike the doctrine of Tawhid. Do not get deceived or pressurized by them into worshiping their false gods nor become a slave to your desires/society etc.
For the explanation of making, one’s religion sincerely for Allah SWT alone, see (E.N. 3 of Surah Az-Zumar).

translation.text: (O Prophet), then warn them of the Day that has drawn near, the Day when hearts full of suppressed grief will leap up to the throats and the wrong-doers shall neither have any sincere friend nor intercessor whose word will be heeded.

commentary.text: In the Quran mankind has been made to realize, again and again, that Resurrection is not far off rather it can take place any moment.
(Surah Al-Anbiya, Ayat 1): The time of the reckoning of the people has drawn near, and yet they are turning away in heedlessness.
(Surah An-Najm, Ayat 57): That which is coming is near at hand, none but Allah can avert it.
This is meant to warn people that they should not become fearless/heedless of Resurrection thinking it to be yet far away but should mend their ways and reform themselves at once.

Additionally, there is a negation regarding the concept of intercession held by the disbelievers. The disbelievers generally believe that their false gods i.e. saints, pirs, etc., whose disciples they are, will not allow that them go to Hell rather they will intercede on their behalf and have their sins forgiven.

translation.text: He knows even the most stealthy glance of the eyes and all the secrets that hearts conceal.

commentary.text: God is aware of every secretive/sneaky/sly glance (the treachery of the eyes) and of everything the heart conceals. They stand in full view; nothing can conceal their reality. A secret may be hidden safely in one's soul/heart, but it is not hidden from Allah SWT.

sections.title: 21-22 THOSE WHO DENIED THE PROPHETS AND ALLAH'S REVELATIONS WERE ALL DESTROYED

translation.text: Have they not journeyed in the land that they might observe the end of those who came before them? They were even greater in strength than they and left behind more splendid traces in the land. Then Allah seized them because of their sins and they had none who could protect them from Allah.

commentary.text:
The Severe Punishment for the Disbelievers
Allah SWT says, 'these people who disbelieve in your Message, O Muhammad, have they not traveled in the land and seen for themselves the nations of the past who disbelieved in their Prophets (PBU Them), for which the punishment came to them -- even though they were stronger than Quraysh. They left behind traces in the earth, such as structures, buildings and dwellings that these people (i.e., the Quraysh) cannot match. They tilled the earth and populated it in greater numbers. Yet despite of this great strength, Allah SWT punished them for their sin.

Then Allah SWT mentions the reason why He punished them, and the sins that they committed in the Ayat below.
Lesson: Deception of this world's glamor/glitter/fun prevents us from obeying. Realize that your time too -- just like the people of the past -- will expire soon.

arabic_lines: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَانَتۡ تَّاۡتِيۡهِمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَكَفَرُوۡا فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّهٗ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ

translation.text: They came to this end because their Messengers would come to them with Clear Signs and yet they would refuse to believe. So Allah seized them. He is indeed Strong, Terrible in Retribution.

commentary.text: Attributes of Allah SWT: Strong and Terrible in Retribution
The reason for Allah SWT's punishment was that despite clear signs (Bayyinat) they refused to believe. So, Allah SWT melted out a very severe/strong punishment.

Most people justify and continue sinning by saying Allah SWT is All Merciful. Allah SWT forgives when a person asks for forgiveness and then does repeat that sin. No doubt Allah SWT is All Merciful and kind yet we must remember that He is also Severe and Terrible in punishment.

sections.title: 23-27 PROPHET MUSA WAS SENT TO PHARON, HAMAN AND QARUN AND PHARON INTENDED TO KILL PROPHET MUSA

translation.text: Verily We sent Musa with Our Signs and a clear authority

commentary.text: The Story of Musa and Pharon

This is not so much the story of Musa (PBUH), as much as it is an introduction to the story of the one man in the court of Pharon who believed: see Ayat 28 below. The Surah's title ("The Believer") refers to him.

Musa (PBUH) was sent with such clear signs that left no doubt that he had been sent by Allah SWT.  Each of the miracles that he performed, one after the other, was enough to bring about the conviction that this is not magic rather proof of divine power.  That is why, according to the Quran, Pharon and his courtiers were convinced in their hearts but refused to profess with the tongues that Musa (PBUH) was indeed a Prophet of Allah SWT.

For the other details of the story of the Prophet Musa (PBUH), see (Surah Al-Baqarah, Ayats 49-61); (Surah An-Nisa, Ayat 164); (Surah Al-Maidah, Ayats 20-26); (Surah Al-Aaraf, Ayats 103-162); (Surah Yunus, Ayats 7, 5- 92); (Surah Houd, Ayats 17, 96-97), 110); Introduction to Surah Yusuf; (Surah Ibrahim, Ayats 5-8); (Surah Bani-Israil, Ayats 101-104); (Surah Al-Kahf, Ayats 60-82); (Surah Maryam, Ayats 51-53); (Surah TaHa, Ayats 9-98); (Surah AlMuminun, Ayats 45-49); (Surah Ash-Shuara, Ayats 10-68); (Surah An-Naml, Ayats 7-14); Introduction to Surah Al- Qasas and (Surah Al-Qasas, Ayats 3-44); (Surah Al-Ahzab, Ayats 69); (Surah As-Saff, Ayats 114-122)

translation.text: to Pharoh and Haman and Korah/Qarun. They said: “(He is) a sorcerer, an utter liar.”

commentary.text: The Quraysh made the same accusations about the Prophet (PBUH) that, he is a magician and a liar.

translation.text: One day Pharaoh said: “Let me go and kill Musa;  then let him invoke his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause disruption in the land.”

commentary.text: Here, the meaning of “changing the religion,” refers to the religious, political, cultural and economic system that was prevalent in Egypt on the basis of Pharon’s and his family’s sovereignty. Pharon was afraid that Musa's (PBUH) message would change that very deen and destroy the lifestyle they were used to.
Lesson: Arrogance makes a person irrational and blind to their deeds. Pharon made evil deeds seem justifiable and attractive.

arabic_lines: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰٓى اِنِّىۡ عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّىۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡ مِّنۡ كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِيَوۡمِ الۡحِسَابِ

translation.text: Musa said: “I have taken refuge with my Lord and your Lord from everyone who waxes arrogant and does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”

commentary.text: Musa (PBUH) referred to God's oneness, stating it clearly and fearing nothing. He submitted himself to the One who protects those who seek His shelter against arrogant enemies. Musa (PBUH) also referred to the rejection of the true promise of Allah SWT i.e. the DoJ when people will have to account for their deeds.
This is a very powerful dua for all those who are being oppressed.

sections.title: 28-37 AND EXCELLENT SPEECH OF ONE OF THE RELATIVES OF PHARON IN THE FAVOR OF PROPHET MUSA

translation.text: Then a man endowed with faith, from Pharaoh's folk, who had kept his faith hidden, said: “Do you kill a person simply because he says: 'My Lord is Allah' even though he brought to you clear Signs from your Lord? If he is a liar, his lying will recoil upon him; but if he is truthful, you will be smitten with some of the awesome consequences of which he warns you. Allah does not guide to the Right Way any who exceeds the limits and is an utter liar.

commentary.text:
Musa was supported by a Believing Man from Pharon's Family
At this point, a man from Pharon's own household who had accepted the truth but kept his faith secret begins his long, wise, powerful and skillful argument in defense of Musa (PBUH) that relies on sound logic and facts coupled with the prospect of dreadful consequences. The Believer felt it was his duty to warn, give sound advice and stand by the truth.

He begins by describing the enormity of what they propose to do: "Would you kill a man because he says, 'God is my Lord?'' (Ayat 28). Do such innocent words that imply personal conviction deserve killing the person who says them? Shown in this way their actions appear to be gruesome, horrid and repugnant.

Note: Islam is against any religious persecution. 

He then takes a step forward, saying that Musa (PBUH) has brought you all evidence of the truth from your Lord. Here, he is referring to the signs/miracles that Musa (PBUH) had shown them. All saw these signs and could not argue about their validity (even if they could not openly acknowledge the truth).

The Believer then forces the people to reflect and possibly back away. He says: 'If you regard him (Musa (PBUH) as a liar, you should leave him alone, for if he is lying in the name of Allah, then Allah SWT Himself will take him to task. But if he is truthful you may involve on yourselves God’s torment by laying your hands on him. Therefore, even if you think that he is a liar, you should leave him to himself.
Effective eloquence is one that is not so blunt, giving leeway to others so that they do not get offended.

translation.text: My people, today the kingdom is yours, and you are supreme in the land. But if Allah's chastisement were to come upon you, who will come to our help?” Pharaoh said: “I only counsel what I consider right; I only direct you to the Path of Rectitude.”

commentary.text: The Believer then gives them a strong warning against incurring God's punishment, reminding them that should it befall them no power can avert it. Their kingdom and power will then be of little use. They should remember this and be grateful to Allah SWT for giving them what they enjoy.

It appears that Pharon has not yet found out that the noble of his court has become a Believer. That is why he did not show any displeasure at what (the Believer) said but made clear that he was not inclined to change his opinion. Pharon says that he is guiding people towards success (as he views it).

translation.text: He who had faith said: “My people, I fear that you will confront a day like that which overtook many parties before you,
like the day that overtook the people of Noah and Ad and Thamud, and those who came after them. Allah does not wish to subject His servants to any injustice.

commentary.text: The Believer continues his speech. He tries another argument in the hope that hearts will soften to it. He refers to the faces of earlier communities of unbelievers. They testify to how powerfully God smites arrogant tyrants; including the people of Nuh, 'Ad, and Thamud and those who came after them. Allah SWT does not wish any injustice for His creatures – thus punishment is always earned.

translation.text: My people, I fear that you will encounter a day when there will be much wailing and you will cry out to one another for help,
the day when you will turn around to retreat, there will be none to protect you from Allah. He whom Allah lets go astray, none will be able to show him the Right Way.

commentary.text: The Believer continues: 'I fear for you the Day [of Judgment} when people will call out to one another [in distress}; the Day when you shall turn back and flee, with no one to defend you against God. He whom God lets go astray can never find a guide.'

translation.text: those who dispute Allah’s signs with no proof given to them. How despicable is that for Allah and the believers! This is how Allah seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant.”

commentary.text: Those who dispute with Allah SWT's revelations are committing a sin/crime that is exceedingly loathsome in the sight of Allah SWT and also those who believe. These people resist the revelations of Allah SWT with crooked arguments and objections that are neither based on any sound reasoning nor on the authority of a revealed Book instead their only basis is arrogance and stubbornness.
This seal of the curse of Allah SWT is set only on the heart of the one who is filled with arrogance and tyranny. The seal is not set on the heart of anybody without a reason. Pharon has such a seal.

Lesson: When discussing religion choose your words wisely and carefully. Do not argue for the sake of arguing and do not contradict Allah SWT's laws/instruction, for example, arguing about why hijab is necessary for women? Or why gays are not accepted in Islam, etc.
UNDERSTAND WHAT CAUSES ALLAH SWT'S HATRED AND AVOID IT AT ALL COSTS.

translation.text: Pharaoh said: “Haman, build for me a lofty tower that I may scale the highways

leading up to the heavens and look for the God of Musa, although I am sure he is a liar.” And so Pharaoh’s evil deeds were made so appealing to him that he was hindered from the ˹Right˺ Way. But the plotting of Pharaoh was only in vain.

commentary.text: How Pharon mocked the Lord of Musa

Interjecting the speech of the Believer as though he has no regard for what was being said, Pharaoh arrogantly tells his minister, Haman, to: 'Build me a high tower so that I may climb it to see where the God of whom this Musa speaks, lives.' Even today people ask to see Allah SWT and they do so due to their arrogance.
(For explanation, see ( Surah Al-Qasas, Ayat 38)

sections.title: 38-50 ALLAH SAVED THAT BELIEVER FROM THE PLOTS OF PHARON AND DESTROYED THE PEOPLE OF PHARON, NOW THEY ARE PRESENTED BEFORE THE FIRE OF HELL MORNING AND EVENING (PUNISHMENT OF THE GRAVES)

translation.text: The believer said, ‘My people, follow me! I will guide you to the right path.
My people, the life of this world is only a brief enjoyment; it is the Hereafter that is the lasting home.

commentary.text: The Believer continues cautioning the people not to be forgetful of Allah SWT on account of their pride. He warns them not to get caught up in the fleeting wealth and prosperity of this world, as this will be the greatest folly. He says, 'Follow me as I will lead you to success. This world is but a temporary abode and permanent is in the Hereafter.'

translation.text: Whosoever does an evil deed will be requited only with the like of it; and whosoever acts righteously and has attained to faith be he a male or a female they shall enter Paradise and be provided sustenance beyond all reckoning.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman+ Righteous Deeds = Success – So choose wisely !

translation.text: My people, how is it that I call you to salvation while you call me to the Fire;

you call me to deny Allah and to associate with Him as His partners those regarding whom I have no knowledge (that they are Allah''s partners in His Divinity), whereas I call you to the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving? (Ghafar)

commentary.text: Conclusion of the Believer's Words and the ultimate Destiny of both Parties

The Believer expresses amazement that he is calling people to what saves them from punishment, while they call him to what will lead him to the fire. The difference between his and their calls cannot be greater. He calls them to believe in One God, whose work/creation in the universe testifies to His oneness, limitless ability and infinite power. They should believe in Him so that He forgives them, as He is the most forgiving (Ghafar) Name of the Surah. While they call him to disbelieve in God, to associate with Him beings of whom he has no knowledge such as idols, myths, legends and paradoxes.

arabic_lines: فَسَتَذۡكُرُوۡنَ مَاۤ اَقُوۡلُ لَـكُمۡؕ وَاُفَوِّضُ اَمۡرِىۡۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بَصِيۡرٌۢ بِالۡعِبَادِ

translation.text: Soon you shall remember what I say to you. I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is watchful over His servants.”

commentary.text: The Believer was certain that he would have to bear the wrath of the entire kingdom of Pharon in consequence of his speaking the truth yet he performed his duty only with his trust in Allah SWT. And what an honor did he receive from Allah SWT – his speech/words recorded in the Quran for all time.
Lesson: What a beautiful reminder for all Believers that Allah SWT will always protect and take care of us.

translation.text: So Allah protected him from the evil of their schemes. And Pharaoh’s people were overwhelmed by an evil punishment:

arabic_lines: اَلنَّارُ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا غُدُوًّا وَّعَشِيًّا ۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ اَدۡخِلُوۡۤا اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اَشَدَّ الۡعَذَابِ

translation.text: they are exposed to the Fire ˹in their graves˺ morning and evening. And on the Day the Hour will be established ˹it will be said˺, “Admit Pharaoh’s people into the harshest punishment ˹of Hell˺.”

commentary.text: This Ayat is an express proof of the torment of barzakh or the torment of the grave. Allah SWT here has in clear words mentioned two stages of the torment, a lesser torment, which is being given now to Pharon and his people before the coming of Resurrection when they are presented before the fire of Hell morning and evening, striking terror in their hearts at seeing the Hell which they will have to enter ultimately.

Then at the time of Resurrection, they will be given the real and greater punishment which is destined for them, i.e. they will be hurled into the same Hell, which they are being made to witness since the time they were drowned till today. Note: This is not specially meant for the Pharaoh and his people; but all culprits (disbelievers) will witness the evil end which is awaiting them from the hour of death till Resurrection.

On the other hand, the righteous people are made to continually see the pleasant picture of the good end that Allah SWT has ready for them. In Bukhari, Muslim, the Prophet (PBUH) said: ‘Whoever from among you dies is shown his final resting place morning and evening continually, whether he be a dweller of Paradise or of Hell.’
For further details, see (Surah Al-Anfaal, Ayats 50-51); (Surah An-Nahal, Ayats 28-32); (Surah Al-Mominoon, Ayats 99-100 )and (E.Ns 22, 23 of Surah YaSeen).

translation.text: The keepers will reply, “Did your messengers not ˹constantly˺ come to you with clear proofs?” They will say, “Yes ˹they did˺.” The keepers will say, “Then pray! Though the prayer of the disbelievers is only in vain.”

commentary.text: The keepers of hell will say, ‘Then pray! Though the prayer of the disbelievers is only in vain’…means, you are on your own. We will not pray on your behalf or listen to you, moreover, it is all the same whether you offer supplication or not, because Allah will not respond and He will not lighten the torment for you.' And the invocation of the disbelievers is nothing but in vain…meaning, it will not be accepted or responded to.

Similarly, reflect upon your duas and if your dua is not being accepted reflect upon the following: (i) Are you sincerely, with determination and EXCLUSIVELY making dua to Allah SWT; ascribing no partners to Him. (ii) Sometimes sins come in the way of having our duas answered such as, cutting ties with blood relations, consuming/doing haram things i.e food, drink, attire etc. (iii) Dua is incorrect I.e., "I want it to rain right now."

sections.title: 51-60 ALLAH DOES HELP HIS RASOOLS AND THE BELIEVERS IN THIS WORLD'S LIFE AND WILL HELP THEM IN THE LIFE HEREAFTER AND YOUR RABB SAYS, "CALL ON ME, I WILL ANSWER YOUR PRAYERS"

translation.text: Surely We shall help Our Messengers and the believers in the life of this world and on the Day when witnesses will rise to testify

commentary.text: Allah SWT will help His messengers and those who believe in ways that we cannot even imagine – both in this world and on the DoJ. SUCCESSS IN BOTH WORLDS!! WIN WIN. So, choose wisely!
For explanation, see (E.N. 93 of Surah As-Saaffat).

translation.text: the Day when the excuses offered by the wrong-doers shall not avail them. They shall be victims of the curse and a woeful abode.

commentary.text: Choose wisely! Do be of those that Allah SWT curses.

translation.text: Surely those who dispute Allah’s signs—with no proof given to them—have nothing in their hearts but greed for dominance, which they will never attain. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He alone is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

commentary.text: Once again, we find the grave sin of arguing about religion without knowledge instead based on one’s own need to be right and arrogant.

translation.text: Never can the blind and the seeing be equal; nor those that believe and act righteously and those that do evil. Little do you understand.

commentary.text: DEFINITION OF SUCCESS
Iman+ Righteous Deeds = Success

This is an argument/promise that the Hereafter will take place -- reason and justice dictate that it will occur. After all, how can a man who lives like a blind person in this world, causing mischief by their immoral and wicked deeds, should not see the evil end of their misdeeds and wrong conduct. Likewise, those who pass their lives in this world with open/seeing eyes and believe and do good works, should be deprived of a good result of their righteousness?

Thus, the non-occurrence of the Hereafter means that good and bad both become dust after death and meet with the same end. For in this case, not only are reason and justice destroyed but morality also is proved to be meaningless and absurd. The evildoer would be highly wise, because he gratified all his desires before his death and the good man highly foolish because he kept himself subjected to every sort of moral reframe without any reason.

translation.text: Your Lord said: “Pray to Me, and I will accept/respond your prayers. Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Hell, utterly abased.”

commentary.text: Also see (40: 66)
The Command to call upon Allah SWT By His grace and kindness
Allah SWT encourages His servants to call upon Him and He guarantees a response.
The Messenger of Allah said:
إنَّ الدُّعَاءَ هُوَ الْعِبَادَة
Indeed, the supplication is the worship.
Then he recited the Ayat above (40:60).
Two things deserve special attention in this Ayat:

Dua (prayer) and ibadat (worship) have been used as synonyms here. Prayer in the first sentence has been called worship in the second. This makes it explicit that prayer itself is worship, rather the essence of worship.

“Surely those who wax too proud to worship Me…” has been used for those who do not make dua to Allah. This shows that dua to Allah SWT is the very requirement of one’s servitude to Him, and turning away from Him amounts to being vain and arrogant.

translation.text: Allah it is Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and made the sky a canopy, Who shaped you and shaped you exceedingly well and gave you good things as sustenance. That is Allah, your Lord; blessed be Allah, the Lord of the Universe.

commentary.text: Reflect upon all of Allah SWT blessings, the One who has made the world a safe adobe for us, the miracle of our bodies and provided for all our needs -- so be grateful! Denial of Allah SWT blessings is arrogance that leads people to Hell.

Here again ibadat (worship) and dua (prayer) have been used as synonyms.

translation.text: But believing after seeing Our punishment did not benefit them at all– this has always been God’s way of dealing with His creatures– there and then the disbelievers were lost.

commentary.text: This is the ruling of Allah SWT concerning all those who repent only when they actually see the punishment/the angel of death. Allah SWT does not accept repentance from them.

Hadith: Allah SWT will accept the repentance of His servant so long as the death rattle is not sounding in his throat. Once the death rattle is sounding and the soul has reached the throat, and the dying person actually sees the angel (of death), then he can no longer repent.
So prepare for the Hereafter Now!

(40:9) and guard them against all ills. He whom You guard against ills on that Day, to him You have surely been Most Merciful. That is the great triumph.”
THIS EXPRESSION OF SERVITUDE (DUA) IS IN ITSELF WORSHIP – SOME HADITH BELOW:

The Prophet (PBUH) said: Allah SWT becomes angry with him who does not ask Him for anything. (Tirmidhi). The Prophet (PBUH) said: 'Ask of Allah SWT His bounty, because Allah SWT likes that He should be asked.' (Tirmidhi).

Nothing can avert destiny but the prayer. (Tirmidhi). That is, no one has the power to change the decisions of Allah SWT but Allah SWT Himself can change His decisions, and this happens when the servant prays to Him.

The Prophet (PBUH) said: 'Whenever a Muslim prays, unless it be a prayer for a sin or for severing relations with a kindred, Allah SWT grants it in one of the three ways: (i) Either his prayer is granted in this very world, or (ii) it is preserved for rewarding him in the Hereafter, or (iii) a disaster of the same degree is prevented from befalling him.

Prophet (PBUH) said: 'Whenever one of you prays, he should not say: O God, forgive me if You so please, show me mercy if You so please, grant me provisions if You so please, but he should say definitely: O God, fulfill my such and such need. The Prophet (PBUH) said: Each one of you should ask his every need of Allah SWT; so much so that even if his shoe-lace breaks, he should pray for it to Allah SWT. That is, even in matters which man feels are in his own power still he should invoke Allah’s help before planning his own solutions. Hence, the servant is at all times acknowledging the supremacy of Allah SWT and admitting his own helplessness. (Tirmidhi, Musnad Ahmad).
